The proposed system aims to improve the reliability, speed, and security of online transactions by integrating government regulations and technical mechanisms into a unified control framework.

Laboratory testing showed that the device effectively supports real-time location tracking, geofencing, and data transmission with low energy consumption.

As an archipelagic nation, Indonesia must apply appropriate technology such as smart radar that can detect high sea waves from tens to hundreds of kilometers away. This system provides rapid information for emergency response teams to notify communities of potential tsunamis. The research includes the comprehensive measurement of the SIMRAD Radar Helo 6 integrated with SBE 26Plus data for marine monitoring. The radar, positioned along the coast, and SBE26Plus, placed in the ocean, provide real-time measurements for sea level and wave monitoring.
